# Do not delete an editor placeholder after the editor already removed it Plaintext inline forward uses a placeholder line break to keep its container alive. The editor can remove that break while inserting forwarded text. Check whether the node is still attached before deleting it, or the remaining compose setup, including signature insertion, can fail. Scope: compose. Paths: - `mailnews/compose/src/nsMsgCompose.cpp` ## Evidence [Shared lesson record](../records/1e895339e990703ef471eaa21a583eae7ae6613052bc34f227d6d024f6b727d0.json). - https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D324680 - https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/10b99ffadb4f111a9ea18bfb8ddc9cd2ef8b13df Source record: `a48a22d4177484305359fc3e164790a649651fbca6768f1bbc1d85cf4d63cc75` ~~~ placeholder
is exactly that line break ~~~ ## Validation and limits Status: **provisional**. This backfill preserves earlier findings and their uncertainty. It does not count unstudied commits as complete. Historical test outcomes remain reported outcomes. No runtime tests or builds were rerun for publication. Supporting source excerpts and references are included in the shared records. ## Correction The earlier capture stayed in the private local store. This contribution places the learned claim in the shared repository. Earlier lesson records: `561987874901a4be5d2675b4fef38e8c58f47e61d338761786343cc5fa639a03`.
